_source: Character sprites by rvros — Animated Pixel Adventurer (https://rvros.itch.io/animated-pixel-hero), plus the bow animation from the same artist's Adventurer-Bow add-on. Personal and commercial use allowed, modification allowed, resale of the asset pack prohibited. Credit appreciated, not required.
_sheet: assets/adventurer.png is composited from the pack's individual 50x37 frames, one animation per row, in the order this game asks for them. The original pack is NOT redistributed here.
_note: Blank the 'sheet' field to fall back to the rectangle renderer, which stays fully playable. See ASSETS.md.

player._walkSharesTheRunRow: The pack has no walk cycle, so walking is the run row at a slower cadence — same legs, visibly slower, which is exactly what the speed state means.
